record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, increase the padding-aware uniform recent-four-state mean contribution from 0.20 to 0.30: output=0.70*current_state+0.30*recent_mean. The regression at 0.10 motivates testing stronger local-interest smoothing while preserving the successful four-state window and uniform weighting. Keep features, embedding parameterization, causal backbone, scoring, loss and optimizer fixed. Preserve causal training and final-real-position inference; update readout metadata and the predictor writer consistently, with one checkpoint per category.
